raw:
Hamilton won the most Hungarian Grands Prix from 2000 to 2025, with 8 wins.

I found the winner for each of the 26 seasons from the race reports (the 2009 and 2011 winners came from the 2009 and 2011 reports, which I didn't cross-check further):

| Driver | Wins | Seasons |
|---|---|---|
| Lewis Hamilton | 8 | 2007, 2009, 2012, 2013, 2016, 2018, 2019, 2020 |
| Michael Schumacher | 2 | 2001, 2004 |
| Sebastian Vettel | 2 | 2015, 2017 |
| Max Verstappen | 2 | 2022, 2023 |
| Jenson Button | 2 | 2006, 2011 |
| Mika Häkkinen, Rubens Barrichello, Fernando Alonso, Kimi Räikkönen, Heikki Kovalainen, Mark Webber, Daniel Ricciardo, Esteban Ocon, Oscar Piastri, Lando Norris | 1 each | |

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
